annotations.title: Pass on what the person thought of a plan or ranking

description: Use this when: after you gave the person an API plan or ranking from this service, they say what they think of it (useful or not, a price or fact that looks wrong, something missing, the plan they chose), or you work for a provider listed here and a fact about your own plans looks wrong, missing or outdated (include the official page in source_url). Pass the gist in one call: from, kind, and optionally the offer_id, what it is about, and a short message. Do not use this to ask for a field, provider, condition or plan to be covered (use request_coverage), and do not include a name, e-mail address, link or other personal information. Nothing is returned beyond the receipt, and nothing sent here changes the published facts: they change only after we re-check the official page. Example: from user_assistant, kind wrong_fact, about price, message "the page says 49 a month".

about.description: Optional. What the remark is about: answer, plan, price, condition, ranking, coverage or other.

from.description: Who is sending: user_assistant (an assistant passing on what its user said) or provider (an assistant of a provider listed here, about its own plans).

kind.description: What the person said: useful, not_useful, wrong_fact (a price or fact that looks wrong), missing (something they needed was not there), outdated (a price, plan or condition has changed), chose_plan (the plan they chose), or other.

message.description: Optional. The gist of what the person said, in one or two short sentences (at most 300 characters). No name, contact detail or other personal information.

offer_id.description: Optional. The offer_id from this service's result that the remark is about.

provider.description: Only with from provider. Optional. The provider name (at most 80 characters).

source_url.description: Only with from provider. Optional. One https address of the provider official page that shows the fact (at most 300 characters).
